# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 platform preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with updated Linux, GTK4, Tizen, and WebAssembly support. The release adds GTK4 GPU rendering and scaling, restores system-font discovery for no-dependencies Linux deployments, and aligns native assets with current platform toolchains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Moves the bundled renderer to m156 and integrates the current core-fork cleanup. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208), [#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — No-dependencies Linux deployments can again discover system fonts without bundling the optional native dependency set. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling** — GTK4 applications can use native GPU rendering with correct pixel scaling for sharper output on high-density displays. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Current platform toolchains aligned** — Updates .NET 11 preview and WebAssembly assets, requires the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 build toolchain, and restores the WinUI Windows SDK default. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235), [#5273](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5273), [#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 aligns its native assets and build configuration with the .NET 11 preview and current platform toolchains.
